fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 2, at d0e9c974d: `go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run Build -v` passes (TestBuildText, TestBuildPreHandoffChecklist, TestBuildCommitsOwnActorRecord, TestBuildTrailersInOneFinalParagraph, TestBuildVerifierRerunsChecks); `go test -trimpath ./internal/guide` and `go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow` exit 0, and workflow_test.go:626 asserts the build.toml builder prompt names the 'pre-handoff checklist' and the `Checks:` block. In build.md, the builder section names the acceptance commands, `rhiza ship generate`, `rhiza render`, folding in the files they change, and a `Checks:` block of commands with exit codes. The example puts Checks: above the one final trailer paragraph, which keeps Change/Actor/Leaf/Co-Authored-By together. The fix commit restores the three majors from attempt 1: 'build only that leaf', 'after its recording command succeeded' and '`Co-Authored-By:` included, in the one final paragraph, no blank line'. build_test.go now pins all three. In a clean detached worktree, `rhiza check` reports only stale-render failures for run actors. All but this commit's own actor were already failing at the parent a56cf9a13, and the run's post-build render covers them.
